entities.name: Erika Nyström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Erika Nyström is a professional Finnish–Cypriot female beach volleyball player. Her twin sister, Emilia, is also a beach volleyball player. She stands 1.79 m tall and weighs 65 kg (143 lb). Erika is the first born of the identical twins and they are both from Muurame, Finland.
